@programPrefixes_some_of_primitivePathFresh : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate]
  (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate) (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap)) (state : Rate × Cap) (seen : List Rate)
  {message rateCoins : List Rate} {capacityCoins : List Cap},
  PrimitivePathFresh ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins →
    ∃ result, programPrefixes ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result
@ConstructionReturnsLastRate : {Rate Cap : Type} →
  [AddCommGroup Rate] →
    [DecidableEq Rate] →
      Rate × Cap → Oracle (List Rate) Rate → Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap) → List Rate → List Rate → List Cap → Prop
@TerminalPrimitiveFreshTo : {Rate Cap : Type} →
  [AddCommGroup Rate] →
    Rate →
      Oracle (List Rate) Rate →
        Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap) → Rate × Cap → List Rate → List Rate → List Rate → List Cap → Prop
@programPrefixes_fresh_final_rate : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate]
  (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate) (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap)) (state : Rate × Cap) (seen : List Rate)
  {message rateCoins : List Rate} {capacityCoins : List Cap} {result : PrefixProgramState Rate Cap},
  message ≠ [] →
    PrimitivePathFresh ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins →
      ro.lookup (seen ++ message) = none →
        programPrefixes ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result →
          result.state.1 = lastRateCoin rateCoins
@programPrefixes_terminalPrimitiveFreshTo_returns_rate : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] (terminalRate : Rate) (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate)
  (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap)) (state : Rate × Cap) (seen : List Rate) {message rateCoins : List Rate}
  {capacityCoins : List Cap},
  TerminalPrimitiveFreshTo terminalRate ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins →
    ro.lookup (seen ++ message) = none →
      ∃ result,
        programPrefixes ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result ∧
          result.state.1 = terminalRate
@constructionReturnsLastRate_of_terminalPrimitiveFresh : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] (iv : Rate × Cap) (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate)
  (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap)) (message rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap),
  message ≠ [] →
    TerminalPrimitiveFreshTo (lastRateCoin rateCoins) ro primitive iv [] message rateCoins capacityCoins →
      ro.lookup message = none → ConstructionReturnsLastRate iv ro primitive message rateCoins capacityCoins
@programPrefixes_preserves_ro_fresh_of_not_prefix : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate) (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap))
  (state : Rate × Cap) (seen : List Rate) {message rateCoins : List Rate} {capacityCoins : List Cap}
  {result : PrefixProgramState Rate Cap} {target : List Rate},
  programPrefixes ro primitive state seen message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result →
    ro.lookup target = none → ¬target <+: seen ++ message → result.ro.lookup target = none
@programConstruction_fresh_final_rate : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate]
  (iv : Rate × Cap) (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate) (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap))
  (message rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap),
  message ≠ [] →
    PrimitivePathFresh ro primitive iv [] message rateCoins capacityCoins →
      ro.lookup message = none →
        ∃ result,
          programConstruction iv ro primitive message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result ∧
            result.state.1 = lastRateCoin rateCoins
@programConstruction_preserves_ro_fresh_of_not_prefix : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] (iv : Rate × Cap) (ro : Oracle (List Rate) Rate)
  (primitive : Oracle (Rate × Cap) (Rate × Cap)) (message rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap)
  {result : PrefixProgramState Rate Cap} {target : List Rate},
  programConstruction iv ro primitive message rateCoins capacityCoins = some result →
    ro.lookup target = none → ¬target <+: message → result.ro.lookup target = none
@prefixHybridStep_constr_preserves_ro_fresh_of_not_prefix : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap)
  (roundCoins : Fin q → PrefixHybridCoins Rate Cap) (state next : PrefixHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate)
  (xs rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap) (target : List Rate),
  D.move state.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →
    roundCoins j = PrefixHybridCoins.construction rateCoins capacityCoins →
      prefixHybridStep D iv roundCoins state j = Except.ok next →
        state.ro.lookup target = none → ¬target <+: x :: xs → next.ro.lookup target = none
@prefixHybridStep_constr_of_primitivePathFresh : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap)
  (roundCoins : Fin q → PrefixHybridCoins Rate Cap) (state : PrefixHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate)
  (xs rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap),
  D.move state.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →
    roundCoins j = PrefixHybridCoins.construction rateCoins capacityCoins →
      rateCoins.length = (x :: xs).length ∧ capacityCoins.length = (x :: xs).length →
        PrimitivePathFresh state.ro state.primitive iv [] (x :: xs) rateCoins capacityCoins →
          state.ro.lookup (x :: xs) = none →
            ∃ next,
              prefixHybridStep D iv roundCoins state j = Except.ok next ∧
                next.ans = state.ans ++ [SpAnswer.rate (lastRateCoin rateCoins)]
@prefixHybridStep_constr_of_returnsLastRate : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate]
  {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap) (roundCoins : Fin q → PrefixHybridCoins Rate Cap)
  (state : PrefixHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate) (xs rateCoins : List Rate) (capacityCoins : List Cap),
  D.move state.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →
    roundCoins j = PrefixHybridCoins.construction rateCoins capacityCoins →
      rateCoins.length = (x :: xs).length ∧ capacityCoins.length = (x :: xs).length →
        ConstructionReturnsLastRate iv state.ro state.primitive (x :: xs) rateCoins capacityCoins →
          ∃ next,
            prefixHybridStep D iv roundCoins state j = Except.ok next ∧
              next.ans = state.ans ++ [SpAnswer.rate (lastRateCoin rateCoins)]
@workHybridStep_constr_of_primitivePathFresh : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap)
  (state : WorkHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate) (xs : List Rate),
  D.move state.core.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →
    xs.length + 1 ≤ state.remaining.length →
      PrimitivePathFresh state.core.ro state.core.primitive iv [] (x :: xs)
          (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining))
          (List.map Prod.snd (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining)) →
        state.core.ro.lookup (x :: xs) = none →
          ∃ next,
            workHybridStep D iv state j = Except.ok next ∧
              next.core.ans =
                state.core.ans ++
                  [SpAnswer.rate (lastRateCoin (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining)))]
@workHybridStep_constr_of_returnsLastRate : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate]
  {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap) (state : WorkHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate)
  (xs : List Rate),
  D.move state.core.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →

      ConstructionReturnsLastRate iv state.core.ro state.core.primitive (x :: xs)
          (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining))
          (List.map Prod.snd (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining)) →
        ∃ next,
          workHybridStep D iv state j = Except.ok next ∧
            next.core.ans =
              state.core.ans ++
                [SpAnswer.rate (lastRateCoin (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (xs.length + 1) state.remaining)))]
@workHybridStep_constr_preserves_ro_fresh_of_not_prefix : ∀ {Rate Cap : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup Rate]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rate] {q : ℕ} (D : Distinguisher Rate Cap q) (iv : Rate × Cap)
  (state next : WorkHybridState Rate Cap) (j : Fin q) (x : Rate) (xs target : List Rate),
  D.move state.core.ans = SpQuery.constr x xs →
    workHybridStep D iv state j = Except.ok next →
      state.core.ro.lookup target = none → ¬target <+: x :: xs → next.core.ro.lookup target = none
